aggregation: mean within each image, then equal-weight mean across images
accuracy_scope: Shared-anchor image panel; not the full balanced binary benchmark.
selection_scope: Label-informed offline diagnostics, not deployable predictions or proof of learnability.
h2_geometry: Exchange loss = 0.5 * (z_A-z_B) dot (d_A-d_B), bounded in absolute value by ||z_A-z_B|| * sin(theta/2). Normalized alignment removes this mechanical scale where nonzero; neither normalization nor regression establishes causality.

raw_exchange_loss.estimator: least squares with inverse within-image row-count weights
raw_exchange_loss.interpretation: Descriptive association, not causality. Rank-deficient fits use the least-squares minimum-norm solution. Repeated task rows are clustered by image. Cross-validation holds out images, not unseen class combinations.
